svg.title: Mell roadmap
svg.desc: Nine phases. Phases 0 to 2 form v0.1: foundation, core chat, memory and first tools, followed by a quality gate. Then second device and desktop with apps and system controls, capabilities such as media and web plus assisted memory, voice, agents and automation, import, hardening.
svg.text: EACH PHASE ENDS WITH A WORKING SYSTEM
Nothing after Phase 2 starts before the gate passes.
